title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

About the Role

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

This Role Is Not For

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.

Preferred Qualifications

Key Skills

  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. Regional General Manager, Airports

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.

  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Data & Reporting

What You Bring

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

title: Sales & Marketing Director
description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage

  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)

Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration â 50%

  • Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
  • Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
  • Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
  • Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
  • Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
  • Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
  • Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
  • Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
  • Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management â 50%

  • Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
  • Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
  • Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
  • Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
  • Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
  • Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
  • Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
  • Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
  • Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
  • Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
  • Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
  • Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
  • Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
  • Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

title: AI Intern
description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. Weâre solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

Weâre backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. Weâre building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About the Role:

As an Intern Machine Learning Engineer on a 6-month contract, you will help build, test, and deploy ML-powered services on our provider data platform. This is not a pure research role; the focus is on strong software engineering, testing, and robust evaluation rather than novel model architectures.

You will own features end-to-end by collaborating with stakeholders, implementing production-ready code, designing evaluation pipelines, and deploying services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a fully remote position.

What Youâll Do:

Design, implement, and maintain ML-driven services and data workflows in Python.

Apply software engineering best practices, including clean code, testing (unit and integration), code reviews, CI/CD, observability, and documentation.

Build and maintain evaluation pipelines and metrics to measure model and system performance in production-like environments.

Deploy and operate ML services on GCP, including tools such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Storage.

Troubleshoot and improve existing ML services with a focus on reliability, latency, and correctness.

Collaborate proactively with internal stakeholders across product, operations, engineering, and data teams to clarify requirements and iterate on solutions.

Communicate clearly about trade-offs, risks, timelines, and results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What Youâll Need:

Experience as a Software Engineer or Machine Learning Engineer.

Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production services.

Hands-on experience deploying and running workloads on Google Cloud Platform.

Expertise in writing and debugging SQL queries.

Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including testing, debugging, version control (Git), CI/CD, and monitoring.

Experience evaluating ML systems by defining metrics, building evaluation datasets, running experiments, and interpreting results.

Ability to work independently, take ownership, and drive projects with limited supervision.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Comfort proactively reaching out to internal stakeholders to understand requirements.

Bonus Points If You:

Have experience writing code in Java.

Have built or maintained data pipelines or ETL jobs on GCP.

Have experience working with healthcare data, compliance requirements, or PII.

Have used experiment tracking and evaluation tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases, or custom dashboards.

Â 

Benefits of Working at Certify

  • At Certify, weâre building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

  • Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

description:
Für die direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Geschäftsführer suchen wir eine engagierte, souveräne und absolut vertrauenswürdige Persönlichkeit, die als persönliche Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Mitarbeitern, Geschäftspartnern und externen Ansprechpartnern agiert.

Als persönlicher Referent (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine vielseitige und verantwortungsvolle Funktion. Sie behalten auch bei unterschiedlichen und kurzfristig wechselnden Anforderungen den Überblick, bereiten Themen eigenständig auf und sorgen dafür, dass Entscheidungen und Vorhaben zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht um eine klassische Assistenzposition: Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt, Prioritäten erkennt und proaktiv handelt.

Aufgaben

  • Enge und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit dem Geschäftsführer
  • Eigenständige Organisation und Priorisierung des Tagesgeschäfts
  • Termin-, Besprechungs- und Reiseplanung einschließlich Vor- und Nachbereitung
  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Unterlagen, Briefings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen
  • Begleitung des Geschäftsführers bei ausgewählten geschäftlichen, gesellschaftlichen und politischen Terminen
  • Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Aufgaben, Projekten und Entscheidungen
  • Kommunikation und Abstimmung mit Mitarbeitern, Geschäftspartnern, Behörden und weiteren Ansprechpartnern
  • Unterstützung bei personalbezogenen und organisatorischen Themen
  • Bearbeitung vertraulicher und sensibler Vorgänge mit höchster Diskretion
  • Unterstützung bei nationalen und internationalen Geschäftskontakten
  • Vorbereitung und Begleitung nationaler und internationaler Geschäftsreisen
  • Recherche und strukturierte Aufbereitung wirtschaftlicher, gesellschaftlicher und politischer Entwicklungen
  • Eigenständige Übernahme besonderer Aufgaben und Projekte im Auftrag der Geschäftsführung

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Berufserfahrung in einer Assistenz-, Referenten-, Management- oder vergleichbaren Position
  • Ausgeprägtes Organisationsvermögen und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Themen gleichzeitig strukturiert zu bearbeiten
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Gute bis sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Sehr gute Türkischkenntnisse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und modernen digitalen Kommunikationsmitteln
  • Interesse an wirtschaftlichen, gesellschaftlichen und politischen Zusammenhängen
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und ein sicheres Gespür für unterschiedliche Gesprächspartner
  • Selbstständige, lösungsorientierte und vorausschauende Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Diskretion und absolute Vertrauenswürdigkeit
  • Souveränes, gepflegtes und verbindliches Auftreten
  • Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zu wechselnden Arbeitszeiten
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft im In- und Ausland
  • Führerschein Klasse B

Benefits

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Ein abwechslungsreiches und vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Einblicke in unterschiedliche Unternehmensbereiche und Entscheidungsprozesse
  • Nationale und internationale Geschäftskontakte sowie Reisetätigkeiten
  • Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Ein professionelles und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen
  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung

Wir suchen keine klassische Sekretariatskraft, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die dem Geschäftsführer im beruflichen Alltag als verlässliche und vorausschauende Unterstützung zur Seite steht.

Sie erkennen, was als Nächstes getan werden muss, ohne dass jede Aufgabe einzeln vorgegeben werden muss. Sie können vertrauliche Informationen sicher einordnen, unterschiedliche Interessen miteinander verbinden und auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen ruhig und lösungsorientiert handeln.

Wenn Sie gerne Verantwortung übernehmen, kommunikationsstark sind, ein ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent besitzen und sich in einem vielseitigen Umfeld mit nationalen und internationalen Kontakten wohlfühlen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

title: Senior IT Administrator (m/w/d)
description:
📍 Berlin | Bezirk Lichtenberg | 2 Tage Home Office
💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung

Du möchtest nicht nur IT-Systeme verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten, wie moderne Technologien, Automatisierungen und digitale Prozesse in einem Unternehmen eingesetzt werden?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin, welche mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz.

Für die Weiterentwicklung der internen IT-Landschaft wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die Verantwortung für die Microsoft Umgebung übernimmt, Prozesse automatisiert und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen digitale Lösungen entwickelt.

Aufgaben

Als Senior IT Administrator übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung einer modernen IT Umgebung und unterstützt dabei, Prozesse effizienter, sicherer und digitaler zu gestalten.

  • Microsoft 365 & Azure: Administration, Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft 365 Umgebung mit Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune und Entra ID sowie der Azure Umgebung mit Host Pools, virtuellen Netzwerken und Speicherkonten.
  • Systemverwaltung: Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Gruppen, Richtlinien und Sicherheitsrollen sowie Sicherstellung einer stabilen und sicheren IT Infrastruktur.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Steuerung der technischen Prozesse rund um neue Mitarbeitende, inklusive Gerätebereitstellung, Berechtigungsmanagement und Automatisierung mit Power Automate.
  • Netzwerk & Security: Überwachung, Wartung und Konfiguration der Netzwerk Infrastruktur sowie Administration der Sophos XGS Firewall inklusive Regelwerken, Remotezugängen und Sicherheitsrichtlinien.
  • Automatisierung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Business Prozessautomatisierungen mit Tools wie Power Automate, Power Apps oder n8n von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum laufenden Betrieb.
  • Digitalisierung: Aufbau technischer Grundlagen für Automatisierungen, Schnittstellen und Konnektoren inklusive Governance, Berechtigungs und Freigabekonzepten.
  • KI & Innovation: Einsatz moderner KI Tools wie ChatGPT oder Microsoft Copilot zur Optimierung interner Prozesse und Steigerung der Effizienz.
  • Support & Projekte: Unterstützung im 2nd und 3rd Level Support, Leitung eigener IT Projekte sowie Weiterentwicklung von IT Standards, Dokumentationen und Sicherheitsprozessen.
  • Wissensvermittlung: Unterstützung der Fachbereiche beim Einsatz von Automatisierungs und KI Tools durch Schulungen, Guidelines und fachliche Begleitung.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich IT, Systemadministration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Systemadministration sowie Erfahrung im eigenständigen Betrieb einer gesamten IT Umgebung.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 Technologien wie Intune, Entra ID, Teams, Exchange Online und SharePoint Online.
  • Praktische Erfahrung von ca. 2-3 Jahren mit Microsoft Azure, insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Host Pools, virtuellen Netzwerken und Speicherkonten.
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik wie LAN, WLAN, VLAN, DHCP und DNS sowie Erfahrung mit Sophos Firewalls, idealerweise der XGS Serie.
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Prozessautomatisierungen mit Power Automate, Power Platform, n8n oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Kenntnisse in PowerShell Skripting, APIs und Webhooks.
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit dem Anspruch, Themen selbstständig voranzutreiben und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
  • Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen zu analysieren und technische Lösungen verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu unterstützen und als technische Ansprechperson Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch.

Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.
  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.
  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.
  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.
  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.
  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits.

Du möchtest moderne IT Strukturen nicht nur betreiben, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln und digitale Prozesse nachhaltig verbessern?

Dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen, kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Informationen zur Stelle und zum Unternehmen.

title: Buchhalter Finanzwesen (m/w/d)
description:
Vollzeit | Köln | Befristet auf ein Jahr, langfristige Zusammenarbeit erwünscht.

Zahlen sind dein Ding. Bei Rechnungen entgeht dir nichts.

Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert, hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen und möchtest dafür sorgen, dass in der Buchhaltung alles dort landet, wo es hingehört?

Willkommen bei TIGER Deutschland

Seit über 20 Jahren sorgen wir dafür, dass Gebäude und Immobilien im Hintergrund zuverlässig funktionieren. Als deutschlandweit tätiger Partner steuern wir technische und infrastrukturelle Dienstleistungen für die Immobilienwirtschaft, Hotellerie, den Einzelhandel und die Pflegebranche.

Unser Hauptsitz befindet sich im Oval Office Cologne direkt am Rhein. Von hier aus koordiniert unser Team täglich unterschiedlichste Aufträge für unsere Kunden in ganz Deutschland. Damit dabei auch buchhalterisch alles sauber läuft, brauchen wir Menschen, die genau hinschauen, mitdenken und den Überblick behalten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest laufende Geschäftsvorgänge in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung

  • Du behältst offene Posten und Zahlungseingänge im Blick
  • Du unterstützt im Forderungsmanagement und kümmerst dich um die Nachverfolgung offener Forderungen
  • Du stimmst Konten ab und sorgst für eine saubere und nachvollziehbare Buchhaltung
  • Du übernimmst weitere administrative und buchhalterische Aufgaben im Finanzwesen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens zusammen und klärst offene Sachverhalte eigenständig

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst idealerweise mindestens ein Jahr Berufserfahrung im kaufmännischen oder buchhalterischen Bereich mit
  • Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung ist von Vorteil
  • Du verfügst über grundlegende buchhalterische Kenntnisse und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen
  • Erfahrung in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung sowie im Forderungsmanagement ist ein Plus
  • Kenntnisse in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central sind wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und zuverlässig
  • Du findest dich schnell in digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und neuen Systemen zurecht
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Modernes Büro mit Rheinblick im Oval Office Cologne
  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Regelmäßige TIGER Afterwork Events
  • Sehr gute Erreichbarkeit mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln, direkt an der KVB Haltestelle Schönhauser Straße

Dann möchten wir dich gerne kennenlernen. Schick uns deine Bewerbung und erzähl uns, wer du bist und welche Erfahrungen du mitbringst. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch mit dir.

title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

 

During your Internship, you will:

Joining our Growth team involves:

  • Own our Campaign Process: Run and sharpen the automated workflow that qualifies and enriches our target accounts, and take responsibility for the pipeline our SDR team works from.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

  • Build Our Market Presence: Draft posts for our company page and keep our content calendar running: webinars and event announcements, product news, new joiners, and the pieces that build our positioning in the market.

Internal Tech Stack:

CRM: Hubspot

Automation: N8N, Clay

Outreach: Lemlist, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

AI Tooling: Claude Co-work/Code
Content & design: LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Figma

Messaging: Slack & Google Workspace

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

  • Proactive & Strategic Problem-Solving: A track record of independently identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks in processes, leading to measurable improvements in efficiency.

  • Operational Excellence & Project Ownership: Exceptional organisational skills with a demonstrated capability to manage multiple, high-priority projects concurrently, ensuring successful delivery within tight deadlines.

Nice to have’s

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field.

  • Expertise in Growth Stack Technologies: Hands-on experience and familiarity with core automation, analytics, and CRM systems, including specific platforms like Hubspot, N8N, Clay, Lemlist, and Make.

  • Content & Social: Experience running a company's or organisation's LinkedIn presence, or writing experience with an audience behind it - a newsletter or blog of your own.

  • Start-up Experience: Experience in a commercial or operational role in a startup or scaleup.

     

How we support you

Your team lead will be

  • Katharina Mas (Growth Engineer)

You will work with

  • Janos Gründling (Head of Growth)

  • Elise Lecocq (Sales Development)

  • Sara Power Millán (Partnerships)

  • Isabel Bommes Fernandez (Team Lead, Go-to-Market)

  • Sina Zamorano (Team Lead, Climate Success)

Meet the rest of the team HERE.

title: Senior Security Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your role

Capmo is the digital partner on construction sites, with over 100k projects delivered faster and more successfully with the help of our platform. We enable architects, engineers, project managers and contractors to collaborate efficiently and run lean and optimized projects. We are one of the fastest-growing B2B SaaS companies in Europe and stay true to our mission of making hard things in construction feel easy.

Thousands of project managers run their construction sites on Capmo every day — which means our customers trust us with data that is critical to their business. Keeping that trust is the job you'd own.

Help us continue to revolutionize the industry! Find out more about us and come join us in our engineering hubs in Berlin and Munich.

As a Senior Security Engineer at Capmo, you will get to:

  • own product and cloud security end to end — threat modeling, security reviews, secure-by-default patterns, and the tooling in our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, dependency and container scanning, secret detection) that keeps findings from piling up.

  • harden our AWS infrastructure: IAM architecture, network segmentation, encryption, logging, workload security — and encode the baselines as policy-as-code instead of a wiki page nobody reads.

  • build our detection and response capability from the ground up, and be the technical lead when something actually happens — from detection through containment to the post-incident review.

  • own our vulnerability disclosure and pentest programs, and drive remediation with the product teams rather than filing tickets and hoping.

  • back our compliance work (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR) with real technical controls and evidence, and support customer security reviews together with Sales.

  • shape the direction of security at Capmo as a hands-on senior IC — building guardrails that engineers adopt because they're good, not because they're mandated.


What we offer

  • Become a shareholder: Take part in our success with our employee stock option program (VSOP).
  • Grow fast: Benefit from an annual development budget of €1,000 and two Development Days to invest in your personal and professional growth.
  • Fitness, food or mobility budget? With EGYM Wellpass, you get unlimited access to 90+ gyms and swimming pools in Germany – or choose a lunch subsidy or a mobility budget as your preferred benefit. 
  • Think ahead: We contribute 20% to your company pension plan. (only applicable in Germany)
  • Hybrid work model: We work in a hybrid setup — 3 days together in the office and 2 days wherever you work best.
  • Exceptional Team: Join a talented and diverse team with limitless growth opportunities.
  • Culture Day Off: Take a day off for essential occasions.


What you bring along

  • 7+ years of hands-on security engineering, including several years owning application and cloud security for a production SaaS platform end to end.

  • A track record of building security programs — SDLC, vulnerability management, detection and response — not just operating tools someone else set up.

  • Expert-level understanding of vulnerability classes and attack techniques well beyond the OWASP Top 10: you can threat-model a new feature, spot the subtle authz flaw in review, and explain the exploit path to the engineer who wrote it.

  • Deep experience hardening cloud infrastructure at scale (AWS ideally, GCP or Azure fine): IAM, network segmentation, container security, security-as-code — designed by you, not inherited.

  • Strong software engineering skills — you write production-quality code, build automation from scratch, and hold your own in architecture discussions with senior engineers.

  • Proven incident response leadership: you've been the technical lead when things went wrong.

  • The judgment to make risk-based calls under ambiguity, and the influence to get teams to act on them without formal authority.

  • Excellent English; German is a plus. Willingness to be on-site 3 days per week in Munich or Berlin.

Nice to have: building up a security function in a scale-up, detection engineering, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 certification experience, certs like OSCP or CISSP (valued, but hands-on skills matter more).

You're inheriting real infrastructure - HubSpot as our source of truth, a custom-built deal-scoring app, call intelligence via Grain, and company-wide AI access - but the layers underneath are still unbuilt: clean data, automated process, real forecasting rigor, AI-driven workflows. That's the job.
This is a team-of-one role that's essentially a sandbox: a direct line to the founders, a mandate to change how we work, and no playbook telling you what to build first. If you want to build the infrastructure behind a revenue engine from the ground up and see your own builds move real numbers, let's talk.

What you'll actually do:

  • Get the data foundation trustworthy: CRM hygiene, field governance, deduping, enrichment on create
