  • Bring AI into daily workflows: call-intelligence automation, research agents, health/churn scoring
  • Get forecasting and reporting to a place leadership can steer from weekly
  • Make sure what you ship gets used: instrument adoption, train the team, iterate


Your qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on experience architecting a CRM like HubSpot from the ground up - how objects, properties, and data structure are set up - not just administering one that's already built
  • Practical, production experience with outbound/enrichment tooling (e.g. Clay or similar)
  • You've built with AI/LLMs - prompt design, agents, or AI-powered workflows - in real production work

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience as an early GTM-Ops/RevOps hire at another startup

  • Comfort with unit economics (CAC, ACV, payback)

Why us?

You'd be Plato's first-ever GTM Engineer - not inheriting someone else's system, but building the one that doesn't exist yet, and introducing RevOps as a discipline at a company that's never had one. A direct line to the founders, real budget for tooling, and a mandate to change how the revenue team works, from day one. 
This is an individual contributor role today - you'll be doing the building yourself, not managing a team. If this function grows as Plato scales, you'd be the one shaping what it becomes, not stepping into a structure someone else already defined.
Because the function touches everything - data, process, automation, AI - you won't be boxed into one lane. If you want to see your own build move a real number within your first 90 days, this is that role.

  • Sie prüfen Prüfungsberichte auf Zahlenkonsistenz, inhaltliche Plausibilität und sprachliche Korrektheit und berücksichtigen dabei interne Qualitätsstandards und Fristen.

  • Hinweise auf mögliche Bilanzierungsfehler identifizieren Sie und geben diese entsprechend weiter.

  • Sie pflegen Berichtsdateien, bereiten diese vor und übernehmen die finale Aufbereitung.

Zudem wirken Sie an der Fortentwicklung, Durchsetzung und Überwachung des gemäß § 55b WPO bestehenden internen Qualitätssicherungssystems mit.

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Word, Excel und Outlook, sowie mit gängigen Videokonferenz-Tools

Beim VSWG verbinden sich fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten mit Rahmenbedingungen, die die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben unterstützen.

description:

Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern in den B2C- und B2B-Branchen genutzt.

Als Senior Content Marketing Manager – SEO/GEO & Blog übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer organischen Sichtbarkeit und unserer Content-Aktivitäten. Du verbindest fundierte SEO- und GEO-Expertise mit redaktionellem Know-how und einem datengetriebenen Blick auf Performance. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen Teams, Märkten sowie externen Partnern zusammen und entwickelst Content und organische Touchpoints, die potenzielle Kunden entlang ihrer Customer Journey erreichen und für Shopware gewinnen.

Die Position ist im Rahmen einer Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet. Diese kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.


  • SEO- & GEO-Strategie: Du steuerst und priorisierst unsere laufenden SEO- und GEO-Aktivitäten und entwickelst unsere organische Sichtbarkeit kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei koordinierst du Keyword- und Content-Optimierungen und stellst sicher, dass relevante Maßnahmen konsequent umgesetzt werden.

  • Performance & Insights: Du monitorst und analysierst unsere SEO-Performance und leitest aus Daten konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und Prioritäten ab. Relevante Entwicklungen und Ergebnisse bereitest du regelmäßig für interne Stakeholder auf.

  • Agentur- & Stakeholdermanagement: Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit unserer SEO-Agentur und koordinierst SEO- und GEO-Themen mit internen und externen Stakeholdern sowie unseren verschiedenen Märkten. Als zentrale Ansprechperson sorgst du dafür, dass Maßnahmen abgestimmt, priorisiert und umgesetzt werden.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Website-Team: Du unterstützt unser Website-Team bei SEO-relevanten Fragestellungen und sorgst dafür, dass notwendige Maßnahmen ihren Weg in die Umsetzung finden. Bei Technical-SEO-Themen wie Redirects oder 404-Fehlern bringst du dein Verständnis ein, ohne selbst die technische Umsetzung übernehmen zu müssen.

  • Blog & Content Management: Du koordinierst und priorisierst eingehende Blog-Anfragen sowie eigene Content-Ideen und entwickelst diese gemeinsam mit relevanten Stakeholdern weiter. Thematisch bewegst du dich unter anderem rund um E-Commerce, Shopware als Produkt, B2B, AI sowie aktuelle rechtliche Entwicklungen.

  • Content Creation & Editorial Excellence: Du erstellst und reviewst Blogbeiträge sowohl aus redaktioneller als auch aus SEO-Perspektive und stellst eine konstant hohe Content-Qualität sicher. Dabei steuerst und briefst du bei Bedarf auch externe Freelancer.

  • AI-gestützte Content-Erstellung: Du setzt AI gezielt für die Content-Erstellung sowie SEO- und GEO-Optimierung ein und entwickelst Prompts und Workflows kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei identifizierst du neue Möglichkeiten, wie AI unsere Content-Prozesse effizienter und wirkungsvoller machen kann.

  • Lokalisierung & internationale Inhalte: Du übersetzt und lokalisierst Inhalte insbesondere zwischen Deutsch und Englisch und koordinierst weitere Sprachversionen, beispielsweise für Italienisch, Niederländisch oder Französisch. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Inhalte auch über verschiedene Märkte hinweg relevant und qualitativ hochwertig bleiben.

  • Publishing & Qualitätssicherung: Du pflegst Beiträge in Contentful ein und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zur Veröffentlichung. Dabei achtest du auf unsere Style- und Design-Guidelines und koordinierst bei Bedarf die Beschaffung passender visueller Assets.

  • Crossfunktionale Content-Projekte: Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Legal und verschiedenen Marketing-Teams wie Partner Marketing oder Demand Generation zusammen. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für bereichsübergreifende Projekte – beispielsweise rund um Release News, neue AI Agents oder weitere strategische Content-Initiativen.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du bringst 5–7 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Content Marketing, SEO oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit. Darüber hinaus hast du ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet abgeschlossen – alternativ überzeugst du uns mit einer vergleichbaren Qualifikation und entsprechender praktischer Erfahrung.

  • Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung im Content Marketing mit Schwerpunkt SEO mit und kennst dich insbesondere mit On-Page- und Off-Page-SEO aus. Gleichzeitig beschäftigst du dich mit neuen Entwicklungen rund um GEO und die Sichtbarkeit in AI-basierten Such- und Antwortsystemen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, hochwertige digitale Inhalte zu konzipieren, zu erstellen und redaktionell zu optimieren und kannst komplexe Themen verständlich, relevant und zielgruppengerecht aufbereiten.

  • Du arbeitest datengetrieben und nutzt Performance-Kennzahlen konsequent als Grundlage für deine Entscheidungen. Aus deinen Analysen kannst du konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten und Prioritäten nachvollziehbar begründen.

  • Du nutzt generative AI und Prompting sicher und zielgerichtet für die Content-Erstellung und -Optimierung und hast Freude daran, neue AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen auszuprobieren und bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke und souveränes Stakeholdermanagement und arbeitest sicher mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Stakeholdern, Agenturen, Freelancern und crossfunktionalen Teams zusammen.

  • Du zeichnest dich durch eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägtes Ownership aus. Auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen behältst du den Überblick und bringst Projekte gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und kannst in beiden Sprachen sicher an professionellen Content-Themen arbeiten.

  • Ein grundlegendes Verständnis von Technical SEO und typischen technischen Fragestellungen rund um Websites ist ein Plus. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Expertise liegt jedoch klar auf Content, strategischem SEO und organischer Sichtbarkeit.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

Warum LPE Immobilien?

  • Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren.
  • Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Fullstack in TypeScript, vom Kundenportal über das Verwaltercockpit bis zu den Services und der Infrastruktur dahinter, auf der grünen Wiese und ohne Altlasten. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite.
  • Du baust KI-Agenten als Produktfunktionalität für unsere Verwalter und Kunden. Zugleich entwickeln wir unsere eigene Entwicklungsumgebung permanent weiter: ein modernes Setup rund um Cursor und Claude Code, inklusive Agent-Graph-Loops und Harness.
  • Dabei arbeitest du nah an den Nutzern: Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg. Wir sammeln Probleme, bewerten sie und bauen die wichtigsten in festen Cycles.
  • Unser Stack: TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du musst nicht alles davon kennen, den Rest lernst du bei uns.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Webentwicklung.
  • Sichere Praxis in TypeScript oder JavaScript, idealerweise mit React oder Next.js.
  • Ein aktuelles Projekt, das du zeigen kannst: Produktionscode, Side Project oder Open Source.
  • Du arbeitest gern quer über den ganzen Stack und magst Frontend und Backend ähnlich gern.
  • Du verantwortest Features end-to-end und kannst bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer ein gutes Interface gestalten.
  • KI-Tooling ist Teil deines Arbeitsalltags, und du prüfst die Ergebnisse genauso kritisch, wie du sie nutzt.
  • Grundverständnis von Datenbanken (SQL) und API-Design.
  • Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust.
  • Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau.
Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Talent und Lernkurve zählen bei uns mehr als Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf.

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.

title: Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem
description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. You will help determine what role ProGlove should play in that ecosystem, which capabilities we should own, where we should partner, what customers and developers should be able to build around us, and where integration itself can become a source of differentiation and recurring business value. 
ProGlove already has the customer base, market credibility, technology and industrial expertise to build on. Our products are used in some of the world's most demanding operational environments. What we are now building is the next layer. 
Over time, success will mean more than making our own products easier to integrate. It will mean creating capabilities, interfaces and ecosystem relationships that customers, application providers and partners actively choose to build around - moving ProGlove from ecosystem participant toward ecosystem shaper. 
If you are excited by the idea of turning complex technology ecosystems into simple, valuable products - and helping shape how the next generation of frontline technology connects with the digital world - we would love to meet you. 
Join us in building the future of frontline work.


What success looks like

  • ProGlove has a clear, customer-backed strategy and prioritized roadmap for Android integration and ecosystem capabilities.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

  • Partner with the General Counsel to produce meaningful Exec-level reporting.

  • Assist with management of large legal projects on GC instruction. Recent examples include M&A diligence coordination, and trademark portfolio work.

  • Support company secretarial administration.

About you

We're looking for a highly organised operator who is energised by building order out of scale-up complexity. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you do need to have run legal operations end-to-end before. The essentials come first below, followed by preferred experience and the traits we care about most.

  • Highly organised with a systems mindset: You keep the plates spinning and notice when one wobbles. You see the workflow behind the task and design for repeatability.

  • Commercial, action-biased, comfortable with ambiguity: You understand what the business needs from legal, get things over the line without waiting to be asked twice, and you're comfortable being the first hire writing the map as you go.

  • Legal operations track record: At least five years' experience running legal operations, contracts operations or a closely adjacent function (compliance operations, legal project management, or legal chief-of-staff), ideally in a scale-up or in-house legal team that is fast paced and where you can demonstrate ownership.

  • Reporting and data fluency: You can build clean dashboards, work with a KPI framework, and translate metrics into a story someone can act on.

  • Outside counsel spend or panel exposure: Experience setting up spend tracking, panel management or legal project management would be useful, but we're also open to someone with the capability and appetite to build this from scratch.

  • Builder mentality: Experience as a team’s first or only legal-ops hire, or a member of a small team in the early stage of the build-out of a legal ops function, would be a strong advantage.

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

title: Senior Compliance Director – UK
description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋

Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly.

This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them.

In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets.

  • Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention.

  • Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio.

  • Establish AI-native ways of working across the team - embedding modern tooling, setting standards for how AI accelerates discovery, delivery, and decision-making, and ensuring the team operates at the leading edge of product practice.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Commercial Finance to deliver scalable, reliable distribution products that meet the needs of TMCs, OBTs, and other partners.

  • Represent Product in commercial and partner discussions, acting as a credible voice on capability, roadmap, and strategic direction with senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Drive a culture of clear prioritisation, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement - ensuring the team is always working on what matters most.

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior product leadership role, with ownership of strategy, delivery, and commercial outcomes for partner-facing products.

  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, with the ability to set high standards and build team capability over time.

  • Commercial acumen and confidence working closely with Sales and Account Management organisations, with a clear understanding of how product decisions connect to revenue and retention.

  • Experience owning or contributing to a P&L, with the ability to translate financial performance into clear product priorities.

  • A hands-on approach to AI - you use it in your own work and understand how to embed it meaningfully into team workflows and product processes, ideally with experience setting AI-native standards across a product organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and UX at a senior level.

  • Ideally, experience working with distribution platforms, APIs, or partner-facing technology in a travel, transport, or similarly complex B2B environment.

  • Helpful if you have experience navigating the dynamics of enterprise partner relationships, balancing bespoke client needs with scalable platform thinking.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

title: Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Conduct security review on emerging Docker products

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

  • Actively participate in architecture design reviews with the team

  • Contribute to a Security-owned project or initiative

  • Collaborate with Docker developers to validate and resolve discovered vulnerabilities

  • Enhance incident response capabilities by participating in on-call rotation and post-incident activities

  • Create and maintain security documentation and runbooks

First Year Outlook

  • Contribute to the security roadmap for improving security controls

  • Strengthen Zero Trust architecture and least privilege access controls

  • Enhance security monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Perform security reviews for major product releases

  • Own and run recurring penetration tests and adversary-emulation exercises across Docker products, and engage with external researchers

  • Support audits and ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27xxx

  • Advocate for “security by design” in all product features

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

Having launched the Million Pound House Draw in 2020, one of the UK’s fastest ever growing products that to date has raised over £150M for charity, Omaze is preparing to build and launch our next big thing. Designed to take our playbook of dream property prizes to new audiences we are seeking a talented and hungry marketeer to help us make it all happen.

Alongside the General Manager you will shape the new proposition and the strategy to bring it to a new audience — defining that audience, positioning the brand and running the creative platform, launching the proposition, and creating a sustainable engine for both brand and commercial growth.

This is a rare opportunity to take something from zero to one and then build the operating rhythm that allows it to grow. You'll start by developing a deep understanding of the customer, defining our positioning and go-to-market strategy, and leading the launch. From there, you'll own the marketing approach for a regular cadence of new campaigns, using customer insight, brand signals and performance data to improve the proposition each time.

You won't have a large dedicated marketing team around you. Instead, you'll need to roll your sleeves up and get it all done, with support from specialists inside and outside of Omaze — including Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, Brand, PR, Analytics and Product — bringing it all together, delivering a clear strategy and executing brilliantly.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong consumer marketing instincts, brand and creative judgement, commercial thinking and hands-on execution.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Build the go-to-market strategy

  • Develop the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for a new Omaze proposition, from initial customer understanding through launch and scale.

  • Define our priority audiences, their motivations and barriers, and the occasions that will drive participation.

  • Define what this new product should stand for in customers' minds, how it should differentiate itself and how it should relate to the wider Omaze brand and product set.

  • Develop the brand positioning, messaging architecture and creative platform that can build recognition, relevance and desire over time.

  • Determine how the new proposition should relate to the broader Omaze brand and existing product portfolio - including driving incrementality

  • Partner with Product, Commercial, Analytics and Research teams to shape decisions around the customer experience, offer and proposition.

  • Build a clear acquisition and retention strategy, identifying the channels, messages and customer journeys most likely to drive sustainable growth.

  • Translate strategy into measurable objectives, combining brand and commercial KPIs.

Lead every campaign

  • Own the marketing strategy and integrated campaign plan for each new property prize launch.

  • Turn each new campaign into a compelling customer story with a clear audience, insight, proposition and creative brief.

  • Ensure every individual property campaign strengthens the brand as well as delivering its immediate commercial objectives.

  • Set a high creative bar and work closely with Creative teams to develop work that is distinctive, emotionally compelling and capable of building the brand over time.

  • Lead the cross-functional marketing squad responsible for bringing campaigns to market.

  • Partner with Creative, Performance Marketing, CRM, PR, Social and other teams to deliver against the strategy.

  • Ensure every customer touchpoint works together as one coherent campaign, from first impression through conversion and repeat participation.

  • Make clear prioritisation and investment recommendations based on expected commercial impact.

Build the playbook

  • Establish the processes, templates, measurement framework and operating cadence required to run campaigns repeatedly and efficiently.

  • Track and develop our understanding of brand health alongside commercial performance, using measures such as awareness, consideration and customer perceptions where appropriate.

  • Design and prioritise tests across audiences, propositions, messaging, creative, channels and customer journeys.

  • Know when to experiment and optimise, and when consistency and creative conviction are more important than reacting to short-term campaign data.

  • Build a strong understanding of what drives performance by customer segment and campaign type.

  • Turn learnings from each campaign into improvements for the next, creating a compounding growth loop rather than starting from scratch each time.

  • Bring customer insight and market intelligence back into the wider business to help shape the future product roadmap.

🤩 About You

We're less interested in a particular industry background than in finding someone who has the right attitude and has shown success at building consumer brands and growing new consumer propositions.

You'll probably have:

  • Significant experience in consumer marketing, brand, growth or integrated marketing roles.

  • Experience taking a new proposition, product or category from early-stage concept through launch and growth.

  • Strong customer and commercial instincts: you can move comfortably between qualitative customer insight, proposition development and quantitative performance data.

  • A strong understanding of how brand building and customer acquisition work together to create sustainable growth.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, customer segmentation and integrated brand and marketing strategies.

  • Strong experimentation instincts and experience using data to improve marketing performance over time, without becoming overly dependent on short-term performance signals..

  • The ability to lead complex cross-functional work without needing direct reporting lines.

  • Excellent briefing and communication skills, particularly with creative and channel specialists.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes where none yet exist.

  • The judgement to know when something needs deep analysis and when it simply needs to get done.

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

description:

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for Full-Stack Engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our Creative & Studio products. These include the Image/Video, Flows, Agentic Creation, Audiobooks and Music/Studio features.

 Your general responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining our products and platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which will be used by millions of users.

  • High degrees of ownership. Developing the product roadmap, and running experiments on some of our enterprise ventures across Creative Platform, Music, and GenAI.

  • Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

  • Building end-to-end API and Core Engineering workflows for enterprise customers, with potential ML involvement: generative output quality on Image/Video models

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company.

Specific responsibilities might include:  

  • Strong product engineering mindset, able to build 0 > 1 (API through to UI). Scoping and building brand new proof of concept products, sometimes directly with partner customers, that could later be scaled to capture entirely new markets.

  • Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping architecture changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

  • Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

  • Working to collect, manage, and process massive-scale datasets to lay the groundwork for the next generation of voice models at the forefront of generative AI.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions.

We do require:

  • Expertise in Python

  • Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

  • Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

  • Experience designing APIs, platform reliability, and building products at scale

  • Bonus: experience deploying products directly to enterprise customers, or ML/GenAI exposure

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

title: Dispenser
description:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

Bolt Pharmacy is our main UK pharmacy brand and part of AIOS, the company building the world's first full-stack AI doctor. This role is based at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn.

AIOS is at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We're the world's fastest growing AI doctor.

We're faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy. We're profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We'll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We'll be Europe's largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We'll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we'll become the world's first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We're a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

You'll own your area of the dispensary, keeping packing stations stocked and dispensers supported. You'll anticipate what's needed, respond quickly and tackle bottlenecks before they interrupt the flow. Every minute matters.

You'll bring precision to the pace. From matching medication strengths to orders and protecting the cold chain to spotting stock discrepancies, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll keep your area clear, organised and ready for the next order.

Working alongside Dispensers, fellow Marshals and shift leadership, you'll help Bolt Pharmacy deliver more as we grow. You'll take initiative, flag problems early and step in where the team needs you. Your impact is hands-on, immediate and felt in every order that leaves the building.

Great performance means packers get a response within 3 minutes, packing runs without avoidable interruptions and medicines stay protected. Your area consistently meets our safety and housekeeping standards, and colleagues can count on you every shift.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working shifts to support warehouse operations.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's dispensing and operations team.

Key responsibilities

  • Keep packing flowing: Patrol your area, respond to packer requests within 3 minutes and replenish medicines and consumables before supplies run out.

  • Get medication control right: Supply only one medication strength and one matching stack of orders per packing table at a time, verifying the match before replenishing.

  • Protect the cold chain: Follow cold-chain procedures and Good Distribution Practice (GDP) requirements, returning temperature-controlled medicines to the fridge immediately when no longer needed.

  • Handle medicines safely: Use designated holding areas, never leave medicines unattended in walkways or packing areas, and immediately quarantine damaged or suspect stock for Shift Lead review.

  • Keep the floor safe and ready: Clear cardboard, keep stations tidy and exits unobstructed, remove immediate hazards and report concerns promptly. Operate equipment only within your training and authorisation.

  • Work as one team: Support fellow Marshals, cover neighbouring areas during breaks and promptly flag stock discrepancies or rotation errors.

Need to have

  • Warehouse knowledge: You understand warehouse operations, stock control, Health & Safety and GDP requirements, and put them into practice.

  • Attention to detail: You check medication strengths, order matches and storage conditions carefully. Accuracy is essential.

  • Ownership: You stay organised, anticipate what's needed and manage your area independently as priorities change.

  • Teamwork: You communicate clearly, flag issues early and bring reliable, consistent effort to every shift.

  • A hands-on approach: You can fulfil the role's physical duties, including continuous on-foot activity and routine manual handling.

Nice to have

  • Regulated operations: You've worked in regulated warehousing, logistics, pharmacy or healthcare.

  • Cold-chain knowledge: You understand how to handle temperature-controlled medicines and protect them throughout the packing process.

  • Warehouse systems: You've used warehouse management tools to track stock and identify discrepancies.

  • Equipment qualifications: You hold forklift or pump truck certification, or baler sign-off. If you don't, we'll provide training.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe.

À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes :

1) Gouvernance & Suivi de la Conformité

  • Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe.

  • Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche).

  • Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP.

  • Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.).

  • Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe.

2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel

  • Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DSI/RSSI) sur la sécurisation des données pour assurer la gestion des incidents de sécurité (incluant la préparation des notifications aux autorités) dans les délais impartis.

  • Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis.

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design).

3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act)

  • Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design).

  • Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables.

4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation

  • Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.).

  • Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires.

  • Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe.


Ce que l’on attend de vous :

  • Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master 2 en droit du numérique, droit des nouvelles technologies, protection des données et/ou spécialisation DPO et disposez d’une expérience confirmée de 7 ans minimum en protection des données (une expérience en tant que DPO ou DPO adjoint est fortement appréciée).

  • L'obtention d'une certification reconnue (type IAPP : CIPP/E, CIPM) constitue un véritable atout.

  • Vous disposez d’une excellente maîtrise opérationnelle du RGPD et des réglementations liées à la protection des données, et d’une connaissance pratique des réglementations internationales (CCPA/CPRA, UK GDPR, PIPEDA, etc.).

  • Vous maîtrisez des enjeux liés au traitement des données des mineurs et aux mécanismes de vérification d'âge.

  • Vous faites preuve de solides connaissances de la réglementation relative à l’encadrement de l’IA (AI Act / RIA) et des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'IA.

  • Vous maîtrisez le français et l’anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral (rédaction et négociation autonome de contrats).

  • Vous disposez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles.

Ce que l’on dit de vous :

  • Vous faites montre d’une approche par les risques affirmée, pragmatique et orientée business (capacité à hiérarchiser les enjeux et à formuler des réponses opérationnelles proportionnées).

  • Vous êtes reconnu·e pour votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse, de synthèse et démontrez une forte autonomie dans la gestion des dossiers.

  • Vous faites preuve de pédagogie et savez expliquer et vulgariser des concepts juridiques complexes de manière claire auprès d’interlocuteurs variés (techniques, métiers, Direction).

  • Vos aptitudes relationnelles et de communication seront des atouts clés pour réussir dans ce poste.

Ce que nous offrons :
